_description: Canonical technical structure for TEXTORO preset JSON documents

fields.name: string - Human-readable preset name (Required)
fields.category: string - type | box | motion | compound | templates (Required)
fields.faIcon: string - Phosphor Bold vector icon class (Optional, e.g. 'ph-bold ph-sparkle')
fields.description: string - Technical description of preset effect (Optional)
fields.builtin: boolean - Flag indicating factory preset status (Optional, default: false)
fields.author: string - Creator or studio attribution (Optional)
fields.inLibrary: boolean - Display flag for Motion Arena grid (Optional)

values.wordMode: boolean - Word-by-word reveal instead of character-by-character
values.cursorBefore: boolean - Position cursor before text (RTL mode)
values.cursorType: number - 0: Bar, 1: Underscore, 2: Solid, 3: Half, 4: Thin, 5: Dot, 6: Diamond, -1: Custom
values.customCursor: string - Custom character symbol when cursorType is -1
values.cursorColor: array [R,G,B] 0-1 or hex string - Cursor color
values.cursorSpacing: number 0-50 - Horizontal pixel spacing from text
values.blinkSpeed: number 0.5-10 - Cursor blink frequency in Hz
values.blinkInHold: boolean - Maintain blinking during timeline hold state
values.liveText: boolean - Override text layer fill color
values.textColor: array [R,G,B] 0-1 or hex string - Text color
values.easingType: number 0-3 - Easing curve: 0: Linear, 1: Ease Out, 2: Ease In, 3: Ease In-Out
values.inStart: number - IN animation start time in seconds
values.inEnd: number - IN animation completion time in seconds
values.outStart: number|null - OUT animation start time in seconds (-1 or null to disable)
values.outEnd: number|null - OUT animation completion time in seconds (-1 or null to disable)
values.blinkStart: number - Blink initiation time in seconds
values.blinkEnd: number - Blink termination time in seconds

values.paddingLeft: number 0-500 - Left horizontal padding in pixels
values.paddingRight: number 0-500 - Right horizontal padding in pixels
values.paddingTop: number 0-500 - Top vertical padding in pixels
values.paddingBottom: number 0-500 - Bottom vertical padding in pixels
values.cornerRadius: number 0-500 - Uniform corner radius in pixels
values.cornerTL: number 0-500 - Top-Left corner radius in pixels
values.cornerTR: number 0-500 - Top-Right corner radius in pixels
values.cornerBR: number 0-500 - Bottom-Right corner radius in pixels
values.cornerBL: number 0-500 - Bottom-Left corner radius in pixels
values.strokeWidth: number 0-100 - Border stroke thickness in pixels
values.strokeColor: array [R,G,B] 0-1 or hex string - Border stroke color
values.strokeDash: number 0-100 - Dashed pattern stroke length in pixels
values.strokeGap: number 0-100 - Gap between dashed stroke segments in pixels
values.fillColor: array [R,G,B] 0-1 or hex string - Background fill color
values.trimOffset: number -360 to 360 - Trim paths angular rotation offset in degrees
values.pathOffset: number - Path expansion or contraction offset in pixels
values.lockBoxSize: boolean - Lock dimensions from dynamic expression sizing
values.parentToText: boolean - Parent box shape layer to text layer
values.autoResize: boolean - Dynamic expression resizing to text source text changes
values.hideWhenEmpty: boolean - Hide box shape layer when text document is empty

values.inStart: number - IN animation start offset in seconds
values.inEnd: number - IN animation duration in seconds
values.outStart: number - OUT animation start offset in seconds
values.outEnd: number - OUT animation completion in seconds
values.syncMode: number 0|1 - 0: Manual timeline, 1: Sync with layer markers
values.posFromX: number - Horizontal start offset in pixels
values.posFromY: number - Vertical start offset in pixels
values.posToX: number - Horizontal target offset in pixels
values.posToY: number - Vertical target offset in pixels
values.posOutFromX: number - OUT transition horizontal start offset in pixels
values.posOutFromY: number - OUT transition vertical start offset in pixels
values.posOutToX: number - OUT transition horizontal target offset in pixels
values.posOutToY: number - OUT transition vertical target offset in pixels
values.scaleOutFrom: number - OUT transition initial scale percentage
values.scaleOutTo: number - OUT transition target scale percentage
values.rotFrom: number - Initial rotation angle in degrees
values.rotTo: number - Target rotation angle in degrees
values.rotOutFrom: number - OUT transition initial rotation angle in degrees
values.rotOutTo: number - OUT transition target rotation angle in degrees
values.opacityOutFrom: number 0-100 - OUT transition initial opacity percentage
values.opacityOutTo: number 0-100 - OUT transition target opacity percentage
values.easingType: number 0-7 - 0: Linear, 1: Ease Out, 2: Ease In, 3: Ease In-Out, 4: Bounce, 5: Elastic, 6: Spring, 7: Spring Physics ODE

compound.description: Compound style combining both Typewriter and Box styling

structure.type: object - Valid Typewriter preset values object
structure.box: object - Valid Box preset values object

templates.description: Complete templates combining Typewriter, Box, and Motion dynamics

structure.type: object - Valid Typewriter preset values object
structure.box: object - Valid Box preset values object
structure.motion: object - Valid Motion preset values object
